basic_info.description: A Fantastic Opportunity! Junior 1BR condominium in luxury building located in the vibrant Polk Gulch neighborhood. This condominium receives great natural light and measures 632 square feet per tax records. Features include hardwood floors, walkout terrace, lush outlooks & deeded parking. Excellent Nob Hill / Russian Hill location with a Walk Score of 99/100. Parking for small to midsize car & private storage. Amenities include a beautiful marble entry, two elevators, landscaped rear garden, on-site maintenance person and evening security. This is a wonderful opportunity for the buyer with interior design talent to create the perfect Pied-a-terre in one of the city's most lively neighborhoods.
